title: macros/<folder>/index.json
description: A macro folder, a namespace for macro.<folder>.<id>. When the folder and a macro both have an if, both must hold.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the folder).

items.description: The folder's members by bare id, in order, each exactly once.

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the folder's macros are offered, or null for always.
